Here are reliable places to buy Korean skincare online (with good authenticity track records). Availability/shipping varies by country, but these are widely used:

## Korea-based retailers (often best selection/prices)
- **Olive Young Global** – Large, trustworthy Korean chain; frequent deals and sets.  
  https://global.oliveyoung.com
- **YesStyle** – Huge catalog; check “Ships within” times and reviews.  
  https://www.yesstyle.com
- **StyleKorean** – Good discounts, bundles, fast promos.  
  https://www.stylekorean.com
- **Stylevana** – Often low prices; shipping can be slower depending on stock.  
  https://www.stylevana.com
- **Jolse** – Long-running K-beauty store; frequent sales.  
  https://jolse.com
- **Wishtrend** – Curated selection (e.g., Klairs, By Wishtrend); solid education content.  
  https://wishtrend.com
- **Masksheet / Soko Glam** – More curated, sometimes higher prices but reliable.  
  https://www.sokoglam.com  
  https://www.masksheets.com

## Brand official stores (best for authenticity)
If you know the brand you want (e.g., **COSRX, Laneige, Innisfree, Beauty of Joseon, Dr. Jart+**), buying from the brand’s official website or official marketplace store is safest.

## Marketplaces (use caution)
- **Amazon / eBay** can be fine **only** if you buy from the **brand’s official storefront** or a clearly authorized seller; avoid “too good to be true” pricing and check seller ratings/return policy.

## Quick authenticity tips
- Prefer **official sites/authorized retailers**.
- Compare packaging photos and look for **lot numbers/expiration dates**.
- Be cautious with unusually cheap prices and vague sellers.

If you tell me your **country**, **budget**, and what you’re shopping for (e.g., sunscreen, acne, dark spots, anti-aging), I can point you to the best store options and a few product picks that ship to you.
